title: Brask wall, east run. Twelfth light, for Ione Brask, breast-high
medium: Twelve bored lights in a rammed-gravel shade wall, hoar, and one sway of the sun. Seen from the ward mast.

stages.name: the ground under one sway, before anyone rammed a wall on it
the Brask wall up, and the keep it holds: hoar wherever the sun never comes
eleven lights standing, each eye open
the twelfth bored: first sway, the sun lying on clean hoar
finished: the piece goes on from here, and the eye opens over six sways
